plan.title: Expose headless WASM-equivalent render path
plan.body: File: src/wasm.rs / src/shell/platform/wasm.rs — add a non-wasm-gated, pure function `render_wasm_parity_frame(dark: bool) -> Vec<u8>` that runs the same paint pipeline used by `present_parity_frame` but writes into an in-memory buffer instead of a DOM canvas, so it's callable from native test binaries without a browser. Reuse existing paint.rs/canvas.rs calls already proven identical per CLAUDE.md parity claims.
plan.acceptance: `cargo test --lib render_wasm_parity_frame` (unit smoke test asserting non-empty buffer of correct size) passes.

plan.title: Wire tests/wasm_parity.rs to call both functions and assert byte equality
plan.body: File: tests/wasm_parity.rs — implement the test body: call `build_reference_frame(false)` and `render_wasm_parity_frame(false)`, assert `Vec<u8>` equal; repeat for `true` (dark). Assert dimensions equal via `parity_frame_size()`-equivalent before content diff.
plan.acceptance: `cargo test --test wasm_parity` passes locally, 0 differing bytes reported for both light and dark.

plan.body: File: tests/wasm_parity.rs — on mismatch, compute first differing index/count and include in panic message (`"parity mismatch: N/{} bytes differ, first at {}"`) rather than a raw assert_eq diff dump, so future regressions are diagnosable from CI logs alone.
plan.acceptance: temporarily corrupt one byte in test, run `cargo test --test wasm_parity`, confirm message reports exact diff count; revert corruption.
